avis.texte: I love love this product! I've been using mediheal for about I wanna say a year or two now, I originally started with the light blue one, but once I found the different types and found out about the watermide I haven't looked back. I have terrible dry skin and also sensitive, so the brand itself is great, but the watermide just adds a hydration that I just love, especially pairing with my serum, sometimes I honestly feel like I don't even have to put on moisturizer. The only bad thing is that it's TERRIBLE for when you're traveling. Maybe I just haven't had the best of luck so do not let me deter you from getting this product. But every time I go out of town and pack my facial products, almost always these pads find a way to tussle and turn about in my luggage and somehow open and leak. Or just leak period. I don't know if the packaging is just super sensitive and causes the top to come open or if you just don't have it sitting upright it leaks from the sides and just all-over, I do not know! I'm starting to think my best bet is to just keep the box for anytime I travel and see how that holds up in my luggage to hopefully seal it and prevent any leaking.

really wanted to love these. I was hoping these would leave me dewy and plump on days when I don't want to do a full sheet mask. Sadly, these felt like all the juicy goodness evaporated the longer I had them on. I've never had a sheet mask or toner pad make my skin feel drier after. It was odd since these have such good reviews. sometimes it's best to just stick with what you know works well instead of trying something new. :(
I struggled with dry skin for years and used many different products. This product is the only thing that actually moisturize my skin and stays moisturized throughout the day. 10/10 would recommend
So happy one of the workers helped me pick this out my skin looks so smooth and my pores have shrunk.

avis.titre: the best toner pads if you have dry, sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I loved it! Even when i used them the first time it hydrated my skin and helped with irritation and redness. Def recommend if you struggle with dry/dehydrated skin and rosacea :)

These have potential but with the pads being thin you can barely seperate them! I've bought two mediheal products and the tweezers have gotten stiffer, good luck if you have mobility issues. I just got angry and grabbed them with my hands which defeated the purpose. Its frustrating.
These are great for hydration. Healed my skin barrier so fast
this works great if you have dry/combo sensitive skin. It's so moisturizing and really calms your skin

One thin little pad provides enough hydrating serumy product for the whole face. Sometimes I use a handful & leave them on my face like a mask. Get the neck too. Meant to be used under a moisturizer! These are hydrating, need to be combined with moisturizer.

This is my first time using mediheal and I really like these! I use one pad on my face and neck every couple days and it makes my skin feel really moisturized. After it dries, I apply serum, moisturizer and spf.

I use these pads before bed, and when I wake up, my skin feels incredibly soft. I've also noticed a reduction in redness. I've always struggled with textured skin, but these pads have helped smooth out those little bumps. I'd definitely recommend them!
Really like this product dor healing the skin. If you have senstive dry skin. Totally recommend

Soft and thin toner pad. Unable to rip for smaller areas. Love using pads for DIY sheet mask. Very watery hydration BOMB! Does not leave a sticky film when left on my face for 10 min. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I've already used up two jars...
avis.texte: I've already used up two jars and I'm planning to buy my third! First off, it's gentle and non­irritating, which is great. The pads are thin but packed with essence, so they adhere well to the skin without falling off. It's perfect for use before makeup as it reduces skin heat, making it a must­have for flawless makeup application! Compared to other pads, it's definitely more effective at cooling down the skin. The only slight inconvenience is that the pads are so thin that it can be a bit fiddly to separate them one by one. While I love how thin they are, it's just a tiny bit annoying to peel them apart. But it's a minor issue I'm willing to overlook! These pads seem to be a great addition to a daily skincare routine, especially for those with sensitive skin or who experience redness and heat in their complexion. The cooling effect could be particularly beneficial for calming blemishes or soothing the skin after cleansing. The thin nature of the pads suggests they might be ideal for targeted application or for layering in a more comprehensive skincare regimen.

avis.titre: It's great for a quick and...
avis.texte: It's great for a quick and easy cleanse! I always use it because a light wipe over the entire face seems to leave my skin feeling fresh and clean. The sheet is thinner than expected... It seems most suitable to just place on your face briefly while drying your hair. Pro tip: Pop it on while blow­drying your hair for best results!

avis.titre: I used to use only the carrot...
avis.texte: I used to use only the carrot pad, but now I've tried this product. It's incredibly thin. It feels just right to place one on the forehead and cheeks. It's hard to pick up just one when taking them out, so I always end up bringing two or three, which then automatically becomes a pack. I'm a super dry­skinned person, but this is moisturizing. There are no other functional features, just moisturizing. Of course, this alone is not enough, so I wipe it all off and then apply an essence, which is just perfect. My skin is very sensitive, so it sometimes gets a little itchy. I'm not sure why that happens. The benefits of using a toner pad are that sometimes you can just wipe your face with it without having to wash, and it leaves your skin feeling moisturized.

avis.titre: The size was just right to...
avis.texte: The size was just right to use! It wasn't too thick, so it adhered well to the face and was convenient for activities. The pad was brimming with moisture, which was great, and surprisingly, it seemed to hold a lot of it. When placed on the face, it didn't drip off and stayed well­adhered. There was a pair of tweezers included, and I liked that there was a designated spot on the container to place the tweezers, making it very hygienic to use. I did not have any particular complaints while using it.

avis.titre: I loved how this product kept...
avis.texte: I loved how this product kept my face hydrated for a long time! It wasn't overly sticky either, which was great. The generous amount in the package means you can apply it liberally! The container has a pair of tweezers, but it's a bit tricky to grab the pads with them... That's about the only downside.

When I apply this before makeup and let it sit while I do other things, my skin becomes so hydrated. There's plenty of essence, enough to cover your whole face and even have some left over for your hands or other areas. It falls off easily, so I can't keep it on while blow­drying my hair...

avis.titre: As someone with dry skin, I...
avis.texte: As someone with dry skin, I often experience makeup looking a bit patchy and feeling dry underneath. So I decided to give this product a try, and wow... it's legendary! I had high expectations given its popularity, but it exceeded them!!! The pads are thin, so they don't fall off easily when applied. Despite being thin, they maintain a long­lasting, hydrating effect, so I don't feel like I'm wasting them each time I use one! As soon as I put it on, I felt the heat in my skin subside and an immediate boost of hydration!! When used before makeup, it creates a beautifully smooth canvas for foundation. While my skin is usually fine, I tend to experience redness and a burning sensation after cleansing. Applying this pad then gives an instant cooling effect, which I love! The thinness allows for excellent adherence, and my skin feels incredibly moisturized even after removing it! If you're dealing with deep dryness and looking for a hydrating pad, I highly recommend this one. While using the tweezers is fine, it's a bit inconvenient to put the pads back in the container after use.

Skin type: Extremely dry, sensitive, and prone to blemishes As someone with extremely dry skin and severe deep dryness, I found that Water Mide works great as a toner pad. After cleansing, I use it as a toner pad to even out my skin texture. When I place it on my cheeks and forehead, my skin feels incredibly smooth! I didn't experience any blemishes, so I've already used up two bottles. Since it's a toner pad, the pads are a bit thin, so I wouldn't recommend them for exfoliating or refining skin texture.

I'm really dedicated to skincare because of my redness­prone skin! I bought this to help cool down my skin with mini­packs, and it's great. It quickly reduces the heat sensation and provides deep hydration. The pads are a bit too thin, which is slightly disappointing. I wish they were just a tad thicker. It's great to keep in the fridge and use as a cold compress, but it's also excellent as a mini­pack.

avis.titre: I think I used this product...
avis.texte: I think I used this product quite well. Unlike some other pads like Numbuzin No.1 that stung and caused a burning sensation when applied, this one is incredibly gentle. However, I didn't really feel like it provided exceptional hydration. For those with dry skin, it might be a bit too light. Still, I'm using it because it's so gentle on my skin.

avis.titre: I bought this because my dry...
avis.texte: I bought this because my dry skin was suffering from deep dryness, and it's actually quite good! It doesn't cause any blemishes, and there's nothing to complain about

I'm currently on my third pack, and I must say, these pads are incredibly thin, adhering perfectly to my cheeks. To be honest, other pads are often too thick and tend to fall off, which is frustrating. As someone with dry skin, these provide excellent deep hydration, so I exclusively use them now! My concern isn't with the product itself, but rather the packaging. The included tweezers sometimes struggle to grip the pads effectively.

avis.titre: I used up a jar before, but...
avis.texte: I used up a jar before, but this seasonal change is so harsh that I felt I needed something to really tackle my deep dryness. So I repurchased it. I love how the pads are incredibly soft and pleasantly clingy. For some reason, the essence dries up quickly, making it difficult to keep the mask on for more than 10 minutes.

avis.titre: As someone with dry skin, I...
avis.texte: As someone with dry skin, I was bothered by dead skin cells, so I decided to give this a try. Amazingly, after just two days of use, the flakiness disappeared, my skin became wonderfully hydrated, and I noticed a plumped­up feeling. I'm really impressed! Plus, the mask sheets are incredibly thin and generously soaked in essence. I honestly can't think of anything negative to say. There weren't any disappointing aspects to speak of.

avis.titre: When I want to do a mask but...
avis.texte: When I want to do a mask but feel lazy, I just layer multiple pads on my face. I bought these for deep hydration, and they provide just the right amount of moisture for my combination dehydrated skin, leaving it feeling clean and refreshed. The hydration level isn't quite enough for deep moisturizing... They dry out faster than expected. While the toughness of the pads could be seen as a plus, it makes it difficult to cut them for spot treatments on specific areas.
After applying this, my skin feels plump and bouncy I'm not sure if it's that great for deep hydration, and it seems to make my makeup pill afterwards
Butttt it did break me out for the first week so I used pimple patches to sort of counter the breakouts. It really helped my eczema as well.

avis.titre: I'm on my second bottle now...
avis.texte: I'm on my second bottle now, and I've never used pads that give such a deep sense of hydration! I really think I'll keep using these consistently. The product itself isn't the issue, but the included tweezers are a bit inconvenient for picking up one pad at a time. They either don't grip well or end up grabbing two pads at once.

I've gone through more than two bottles! As someone with dry skin, I absolutely love how it keeps my skin from feeling parched when I apply it before blow­drying my hair. It's been a game­changer for me! There's nothing negative to say about this product. Absolutely nothing!
Beautiful things for the face . I've admired this purchase a hundred times. Price and quality

avis.titre: I bought this to use while...
avis.texte: I bought this to use while blow­drying my hair, and it's great! It adheres well to the skin and keeps it hydrated. It's also nice to put on the neck. The mask absorbs well, leaving the skin feeling moisturized, and it's so convenient to use. The only downside is that the pad might fall off if it dries out a bit, but other than that, I have no complaints.
I have skin that is picky with products, and after using this for about 3 weeks now I've seen a significant boost in the hydration in my skin. I really like these!

A soothing hydration toner pad that even super sensitive skin can use without worry. The toner has a pleasant scent and gives a beautiful glow as if you've layered hydrating toner multiple times, while addressing deep dryness. The pads are incredibly soft on the skin without any roughness, making them highly recommended for sensitive skin types looking to even out their complexion. I've used 3 bottles and never experienced redness, tingling, or itching. Refills are available at a reasonable price, and during sales, you can get 100 pads for around $17, which is quite good. It absorbs well without stickiness, leaving the skin moisturized. Recommended for dry, sensitive, combination, and oily skin types. Not recommended for extremely dry or extremely oily skin. While it does address deep dryness, as someone with dry skin, I found it a bit insufficient on its own. Layering with a cream or serum is necessary. Although the essence is generously applied to the pads, when you stick them on and let them dry, they tend to dry out oddly and start to peel off. Also, the initial seal on the lid was so tight that it was difficult to open even with a cutter. Once opened, you need to apply significant force, which can easily lead to spills. Despite these issues, I'm very satisfied with the product itself and would recommend it! I have combination to sensitive skin, and I noticed a slight richness on my nose area. After quickly evening out your skin tone with a hydrating toner, apply a bright

Unlike other toner pads I've used before, these are noticeably thin and soft ­ you can even see it in the photos. But don't let that fool you, they're still packed with hydration. It's amazing how comfortable they feel when left on like a mask, with no discomfort at all. Whether you use them as an exfoliating toner or as a daily mask routine, they're fantastic. I'm eager to try other varieties in the future. The tweezers that come with the pads are disappointing. Out of all the pad products I've tried, these tweezers might be the worst. I'm not sure if it's because I lack hand strength, but I end up separating the pads by hand anyway. I don't bother using the tweezers at all.

I did just buy this product in january and use it about 3 times a week or more if my skin is extra dey. Currently ive been going through the "Retinol uglies" and this (along with a couple other products) has been helping my dry skin! I like that the packaging comes with tweezers and that the pads are very soft on your skin. I usually put on one my forehead in a diamond shape and then i use clean scissors to cut another pad vertically for under my eyes. I leave them on till they fully absorb. It makes my skin care routine feel fancier than it really is! The one con i have so far is im unsure where to buy the refills? I bought this in store thinking this was a cool concept for sustainability (although theres room for improvement) but i cannot locate the refills anywhere? Maybe its just me who cant find them but i probably would not buy it again in this packaging.

avis.titre: I bought this because the blue...
avis.texte: I bought this because the blue one is famous, and I was concerned about deep dryness. As expected from a deep hydration pad, it's really soaked in essence. The pads are thin, so they adhere well to the skin. I'm satisfied with the hydration, so I'll repurchase when I finish this one. I wish it had a cooling effect. Also, it's inconvenient that the pads don't tear easily.

This product is absolutely incredible! It's my top pick :100:. First off, 100 pads for just 20,000 won? That's insane value ­ only 200 won per pad! I bought these to use after showering while drying my hair. I have dry skin, and the hairdryer usually makes it worse, but these pads are a game­changer. Even with my long hair taking about 20 minutes to dry on high heat, the pads don't dry out! It's amazing how much essence they hold. You can even leave them on for an extra 5­10 minutes after drying. That shows just how much essence is packed in there. Plus, I've used all 100 pads and there's still some essence left ­ that's truly remarkable! The cooling effect is also fantastic. You know how your body feels warm after a shower? Put one of these on and it's like heaven. You can literally experience bliss! To sum up: Great value at 200 won per pad, loads of essence, awesome cooling effect, and definitely repurchasing. Five stars all the way! In the attached photo, you can see the included tweezers for picking up the pads. They're supposed to attach to the lid for storage, but after a few uses, they became too loose and kept falling off. Eventually, I had to resort to using my hands to take out the pads, which was a bit disappointing. However, the value for money is so exceptional that it's hard to find a product that compares. Overall, I was very satisfied while using it.

avis.titre: The pads are thin and packed...
avis.texte: The pads are thin and packed with hydration. They feel soft and gentle on the skin. While the pads are thin, the tweezers are quite bulky, making it challenging to pick up individual sheets. It would be better if the tweezers had a more precise tip. I like to apply two pads after drying my hair, smoothing them over my face. Then I gently pat to help absorption before applying my moisturizer. This works really well for my skincare routine.

avis.titre: The pads are soaked with ample...
avis.texte: The pads are soaked with ample serum, which is fantastic for deep hydration. Instead of feeling like surface moisture, it creates an inner glow the day after use. Unlike other pads that can be irritating, Mediheal pads are gentle and cause no irritation. The pads are smaller compared to the case size. While there are more pads as a result, I wish they were a bit larger in area.

I loved how moisturizing it was! It's great for replenishing hydration when used right after cleansing I was satisfied using it overall! However, the tweezers for picking up the pads kept falling off, which was a bit inconvenient

Recently, I've been dealing with dry skin, blemish marks, and occasional breakouts. After trying various toner pads, I wanted to settle on one that's cost­effective and generously soaked in serum. That's why I chose these toner pads. They're thin yet wide, and hold a lot of serum. Even after 10 minutes, they don't dry out. I'm so impressed with their hydrating power that I'm now on my third container. While other Mediheal pads use gauze, which I'm not particularly fond of, these have a smooth fabric texture that feels gentle on the skin. I think these pads would work well for all skin types. The only downside is that the refill package is quite difficult to open. However, I'm pleased that refills are sold separately on the official website. I use these pads before applying toner or when my skin feels hot and red. They quickly soothe and help absorption. With the remaining essence, I gently swipe across my skin ­ not so much for exfoliation, but more to refine skin texture. When I start my toner step after using these pads, my skincare seems to penetrate deeper, leaving a long­lasting feeling of hydration.

Let me start off by saying that I usually use La Mer products in winter - the Treatment Lotion and The Hydrating Revitalizing Serum followed by a moisturizer. I picked up this packet of Mediheal pads mostly because they came in such a cute box that matches my bathroom decor, but also because they are moisturizing. Today I tried them instead of my two La Mer products, and my skin feels the same as it does with the La Mer. So this is quite the economical alternative. I just used this as a toner pad because I can't be bothered to sit around with pads on my cheeks for 15 minutes. The one problem I had is that these sheets are really, REALLY thin and flimsy, and it kept balling up under my fingers as I tried to wipe my face with the pad. Also, without my glasses it was impossible to use the tweezers to pick out one single pad, so I just scrabbled around in the box with my fingers to get one. This seems like a good product to replace my expensive stuff, when it runs out, and in the meantime I'll just keep practicing with them.
The most hydrating thing I have put on my face. I have such dry skin and this really helps give that glass skin look.

avis.titre: The texture of these pads is...
avis.texte: The texture of these pads is really pleasant! I also love that the scent isn't irritating at all. I don't think these pads agree with my skin! After using them, I noticed tiny blemishes popping up and my skin actually felt even drier.

avis.titre: After using it, my skin feels...
avis.texte: After using it, my skin feels so wonderfully firm and supple. It's definitely earned a permanent spot in my skincare collection! There's not really anything to complain about, except maybe that the pads are a bit oversaturated with toner, so you might need to squeeze them a little.

This is incredibly moisturizing! I love how it feels like my skin is getting a hydration boost after using it. There's so much essence in it! Plus, it had a refreshing cooling effect. The tabs come off easily. Also, when opening it, I struggled because there wasn't enough strength to tear it open.

Despite having extremely dry skin, I found this product to be absolutely fantastic! While the pads don't stretch, they're surprisingly large enough to be effective. Unlike other masks that tend to fall off after a few minutes, this one adheres really well, which I love. Even when using it with an exfoliating toner, it didn't irritate my skin at all, which was great! The only downside is that the tweezers are a bit awkward to use. However, if you gently pick up just one sheet at a time, it works well enough.

Instant hydration effect The moment the pad touches your skin, moisture is immediately absorbed, leaving your skin feeling hydrated for hours The strong fragrance might be uncomfortable for those sensitive to scents. It could be a drawback for people who prefer unscented products

As someone who doesn't usually get along with sheet masks, I find this one quite comfortable. Even though it's a toner pack, it's just as effective as a sheet mask. I wish it was a bit larger in size. That's the only thing I find disappointing. Other than that, no complaints.
Highly recommended! The pads are gentle and perfectly combat dryness! There's not much to complain about, but if I had to say something, it's a bit disappointing that it dries too quickly.

When applied before makeup, it creates a perfect base and keeps my skin incredibly hydrated. For reference, I have sensitive combination skin. It doesn't cause any blemishes for me and actually works better than I expected.

Each sheet is incredibly thin and saturated with hydration, holding a generous amount of moisture While these skin pads are meant for wiping, they're too thin and slippery to be effective for that purpose. As a sheet mask, they don't leave lasting hydration. The sheet feels moist, but my face ends up dry Rather than for hydration or as a mask, these seem perfect for cooling down the skin before applying makeup

­ Gentle formula with zero irritation ­ Thin pads adhere well to skin, great for toner pack use ­ Absorbs quickly ­ Instantly cools skin temperature ­ Not much toner in the pads, dries out quickly ­ Difficult to use as an exfoliating toner, pads are too thin and weak ­ Too mild, doesn't feel like it's removing dead skin cells ­ Most importantly, the deep hydration effect is just average Conclusion: Won't repurchase, can't see the big appeal

I accidentally bought this instead of tea tree or madecassoside for my blemishes, but it turned out great! My skin tends to be a bit dry, and this leaves it feeling hydrated. Sometimes when I apply it to areas where I've extracted, it even helps dissolve sebum ­ talk about killing two birds with one stone! So if you're looking for something moisturizing that also helps with blemishes, I'd recommend this. By the way, I have combination dehydrated skin. There wasn't really anything bad, but since I have to say something... I'll just say this: it's super hydrating and awesome! They call it an exfoliating toner, but I used it as a mask. And you know what? It worked wonders!

avis.titre: My face tends to get hot...
avis.texte: My face tends to get hot easily, leading to redness and blemishes. Whenever I apply these pads, they instantly cool down my skin and provide much­needed hydration. It's been a game­changer for my complexion! I can't really think of any downsides. The value for money is unquestionable.

avis.titre: The pads are thin and adhere...
avis.texte: The pads are thin and adhere well to the skin. They provide a refreshing hydration that's great for cooling down your face when it feels hot. Perfect for when you want to replenish moisture. I often use them on busy mornings or when I'm too lazy for a full mask routine ­ just 5­10 minutes on the skin does the trick. The essence seems quite generous. The pads themselves are gentle and non­irritating. Personally, I appreciated that the scent wasn't too strong. I'd recommend these for combination dehydrated skin types and those experiencing deep dryness. You can't carry them around as the essence leaks if the container tips over or flips. The tweezers are difficult to use and inconvenient. As someone with super sensitive skin that's always prone to redness and tingling, using these made my skin feel even more irritated. The pads are tough and don't tear easily, making them difficult to apply to smaller areas of the face. It's great to keep these in the refrigerator before use.

The pads are incredibly thin and generously soaked in essence, so there's no worry about them falling off your face! I also noticed that the product absorbs well into the skin while wearing it. As someone who originally suffered from deep dryness, I've been using this for about two weeks now, and I can definitely see a noticeable improvement in my skin's hydration levels! I plan to continue using it consistently! There wasn't anything particularly disappointing, but if I had to mention something, the tweezers provided weren't the most convenient for picking up the pads. Because of that, I end up using my hands to grab them every time...
The next morning, my skin feels incredibly firm and noticeably improved Not sure if it's a drawback, but the pads are quite large. It might be better if they were split in half

Among the exfoliating pads I've used recently, this one is the gentlest and has the most essence! It's not just an exfoliating toner, but also great for masking. I'm extremely satisfied with how it absorbs immediately without any stickiness, leaving a perfect finish. The pads themselves are quite thin, so they tend to slip out of your hand easily. However, they're convenient to fold and use. When using them, I slip the pad between my second and fourth fingers for better control!

avis.titre: I prefer pads that are full of...
avis.texte: I prefer pads that are full of hydration without any stickiness, rather than those packed with heavy nutrients. That's why this pad suited me so well. It was perfect to use before makeup. I've tried 4 out of the 7 types of Mediheal pads, and among them, this one had the best feel on my skin. It's really difficult to separate individual sheets. They often come out two at a time. Even using tweezers is useless. Mediheal sells refills separately, so once you've used up the pads, you can reuse the container and buy refills at a lower price!

Personally, I'm really enjoying this product and would definitely repurchase it! Gentle on skin The pad material is much softer compared to other brands. Even those with super sensitive skin can use it without worry! Hydration I didn't expect much hydration from a pad, but after using it, I found the hydration so good that it felt wasteful to use it just as a pad. Now I often use it like a mask, leaving it on my cheeks. Texture Usually, for good hydration, products tend to be oily and thick, right? In this case, the texture is moisturizing without being greasy, leaving a fresh finish. Since the material is soft, it might suit those looking for gentle hydration rather than those wanting dead skin cell removal. It's a bit disappointing that the tweezers don't grip the pads well.
There's no real smell to the patches to me. I enjoy using them to hydrate my face. It's part of my routine after I've been in the sun all day.

avis.titre: As someone with dry skin, I'm...
avis.texte: As someone with dry skin, I'm impressed by how incredibly hydrating these pads are despite being thin. The amount of product seems generous too! I can even stick them on my face before blow­drying my hair, and they stay put. While I haven't tried many other hydrating pads, so far these seem to be the best for me. It's true that they're very hydrating, but after about 5 minutes, the pads do dry out and fall off. Still, I'm satisfied because they provide plenty of moisture to the skin while they're on.

I love the packaging! The product itself is soaked in the serum (there's A LOT) so it will never be dry if you keep the container close, unlike many other toner pad products which have little to no liquid inside. I have the purple container for moisturizing before applying makeup and I have to say my makeup hasn't been cakey ever since. However, I took off a star because the packaging actually comes with a clip and while that's nice, it's actually quite difficult to pick up the pads with the clip. If they had a better clip I'd be more satisfied with the product.

My dry skin absolutely loves these pads. I take two and let them sit on my cheeks for 15-20 minutes once a week and then use the excess to rub into my skin all over my face after and it feels amazing. Afterwards my skin is hydrated, plump and bouncy

avis.titre: I highly recommend this if you...
avis.texte: I highly recommend this if you use an exfoliating toner or like to absorb excess oil! In the morning before applying makeup, I cleanse my face, place three pads on it, and then dry my hair. The pads are sufficiently saturated with toner, providing ample hydration. It's fantastic! The pads are extremely thin, which is a bit disappointing. Sometimes 2­3 pads stick together when you try to grab one.

When drying your hair, these really stick on thin and snug without falling off! Unlike typical gauze, the texture is incredibly soft, supple, and smooth, causing zero irritation to your skin. Those with very oily skin might find it slightly sticky~ But it absorbs quickly and shouldn't be bothersome enough to worry about. Apply before makeup while drying your hair

1. Adhesion The pads are thin, so once applied to the face, they hardly come off. 2. Essence quantity Perhaps due to its deep hydration properties, it feels like there's more essence compared to other types of Mediheal pads. 3. Pad size The pads are adequately sized, making them perfect for applying one to each cheek. 4. Refills A great advantage is the availability of refills, allowing you to purchase just the inner contents. 1. Thin pads While the thin pads improve adhesion, their thinness means they can hold less essence and seem to dry out faster. 2. Pad texture Both sides of the pad are the same. It would be better if one side had a texture that could help refine skin texture.

The cooling effect is great for soothing the skin! Plus, there's plenty of toner inside, so the pads never dry out! I'm not sure about its hydrating power... I didn't see any remarkable results, so I wouldn't recommend using this alone. I recommend using these pads before applying makeup. It's best to use other pads to refine skin texture first, then use these pads to moisturize, followed by a hydrating ampoule for optimal results!

I've been using this for hydration in the morning. The gel­like texture of the pads adheres so well to the skin that they don't easily come off. Rather than feeling overly moist, it seems to truly replenish the skin's hydration. After use, I don't experience any deep dryness. The pads cause zero irritation, making it incredibly comfortable to boost moisture. It even lowers skin temperature, allowing makeup to apply smoothly. There's more essence in these pads compared to other Mediheal ones, making them extra hydrating. It truly lives up to its name as a pad that can fill your skin with deep hydration. They don't sell refills. Please make refill packages available! The tweezers seem to be the same for all pads, but while it's easy to pick up the gauze­type pads like Madecassoside or Tea Tree, these gel­type ones are harder to grasp with the included Mediheal tweezers. Please change this. You can put it on your face in the morning and change clothes without it falling off.

avis.titre: On days when I've sweated a...
avis.texte: On days when I've sweated a lot in the summer or been exposed to intense sunlight, I use this when my face feels hot. After using it, my face genuinely cools down. I stick one pad on each cheek and one on my forehead, but the pads felt a bit small for the cheeks. For the forehead, it was awkward to use just one, but also not quite right for two. Since the pad size is a bit tricky, I use the essence from the pack on areas where I can't stick the pads, gently patting it in after applying the mask!

It's thin and moist like gauze. The slightly rough texture seems to help manage excess oil too. Due to its thinness and rough texture, it might cause some irritation when your skin isn't in the best condition. Since it's so thin, you could use it like a mask by applying it to your cheeks and forehead.

avis.titre: I loved the serum so much that...
avis.texte: I loved the serum so much that I decided to try the pads too, and they seem great! My skin feels incredibly hydrated. As for any downsides, I'm not quite sure yet. I'll keep using them and update my review later.

The large pads provide widespread hydration. By moisturizing the face, it helps control excess oil production, which is great. Although it comes with tweezers, they keep falling off. The pads are so thin that you have to peel them off one by one by hand.

After using this product, I noticed a reduction in my skin blemishes and my makeup applies much better. I'm really pleased with the results! The applicator is quite uncomfortable to use. If you've purchased this, I'd recommend using a different applicator or applying it with your hands instead.

I have to share my love for the MEDIHEAL Watermide Moisture Pads. After a long day, my skin often feels like it's been through a desert, but these pads are my rescue team. I use one, and it's like my skin is instantly revitalized with a refreshing splash of Icelandic glacial water. These pads work wonders, transforming my face from dry and tired to hydrated and happy. Plus, they're vegan and eco­friendly, which makes me feel even better about using them. With 100 pads in the pack, I never have to worry about running out. If you're dealing with dry or puffy skin, I highly recommend giving these a try. They're a delightful pick­me­up for my face, and I've been loving the glow they give me. :ocean:

As someone with extremely dry skin prone to deep dryness, I find the hydration excellent. I apply it like a mask before makeup Since it's not made of cotton, you'll need scissors if you want to cut it to size
It's wonderfully moisturizing and pleasant. I'm currently using it as a final layer after my skincare routine. There's really nothing I can find fault with.
The watermide toner pads are so hydrating! I can tell a difference in the texture of my skin. Love this product

After using it morning and night, my deep dryness disappeared. It's absolutely amazing! Honestly, I can't think of any downsides. If you pop it in the fridge for a bit before use, it's super refreshing and totally awesome. Pro tip: Store it in the fridge before use. Using it both morning and night really maximizes its effectiveness.
The essence is abundant and truly moisturizing! It definitely gives a feeling of replenishing hydration I didn't really experience any downsides while using it! I'm satisfied

avis.titre: As a sheet mask enthusiast, I...
avis.texte: As a sheet mask enthusiast, I loved this product so much I bought another one! It really helps calm down the heat on my skin after cleansing, and the cooling effect is amazing. My skin is super sensitive, so I have to be careful with skincare products and can't even use gauze­like pads... but this one worked perfectly for me! The pads are thin, so your skin shows through when applied, but I think this actually helps it adhere better and lock in deep hydration. I'm absolutely thrilled with this product! There wasn't anything I disliked about it! If I had to nitpick, I'd say the price is a bit high...

It's amazing for deep dryness! When I apply this, my skin feels so plump and hydrated! It might be because it's too soft, but it keeps sliding down my face It works even better if you store it in the refrigerator!

This is my first time buying these and I got a few different pads for different concerns. So far I really like this one and it does hydrate and feel cool on the skin. Cant speak to the long term use as I just received them. But i did want to add this warning to others- the lid was still sealed so I know they werent tampered with but the pads were everywhere in the container. I pulled one out and a bunch came with it because even though it looked like it was on the top, it was actually partially under half the other pads. Im not sure if it was due to poor packaging or how they shifted during transit but I basically had to use the tweezers provided to realign the entire package.

The mask adheres perfectly to the skin, so you can bend over and dry your hair without any issues! It doesn't cause makeup to pill, cools and soothes the skin, and it's great to use before applying makeup. It's perfect for a quick cooling effect on the cheeks in the morning when a full face mask might be too much. The scent is so subtle it's barely noticeable, making it universally appealing. This mask provides more hydration than oil. It's important to note that this isn't an exfoliating toner pad! The pads are even thinner than a typical sheet mask. I use them to fill in gaps around the nose, eyes, and mouth when using a full face mask, or to prevent moisture loss while drying my hair. They're too thin for exfoliation ­ think of them as mini sheet masks.

I was really satisfied using this as a toner pack! When I wiped my face, it wasn't irritating at all and left my skin feeling incredibly smooth and refined. Usually, toner pads can feel a bit rough, but I didn't experience that at all with this product. While the thinness allows for a super close fit to the skin, it also means it doesn't seem to hold as much essence as I'd like. It seems gentle enough to use as an exfoliating toner without any worries.
It's pretty decent. I'd say it's alright for everyday use. The downside? Hmm... I like it so much that I keep reaching for it, which means it disappears quickly!

avis.titre: I've been using this for about...
avis.texte: I've been using this for about a month now. I tend to use it in the morning before applying makeup when I feel my skin needs hydration. When I place the pre­chilled pads from the fridge on my entire face for a few minutes and then remove them, my skin feels genuinely moisturized, and my makeup applies beautifully. It's great that there's a generous amount of product and plenty of ampoule, so it won't dry out. I also appreciate how thin the pads are. Unlike other pad products, this one has a clip on the lid, making it convenient to use, which I really like. Unlike other pads, these don't have an embossed texture, so it's difficult to refine skin texture with them. I think you'll be satisfied if you use them simply for hydration, like a sheet mask. It's really fantastic when you keep it in the fridge and use it before applying makeup!

My skin absolutely loves this. I like that it is more of a hydrating toner. I've gone through about 3 tubs now and I don't think I'll be stopping anytime soon! It's a must have in my skincare routine.
Literally the best toner pads everrrr. I use them in the morning or sometimes at night as a facemask. I've only tried the purple box, but they are my favorite.

avis.titre: The pads have a soft texture...
avis.texte: The pads have a soft texture and are soaked with plenty of essence, making them feel wonderfully hydrating. They seem to have excellent moisturizing effects. These are so good that it's hard to find any downsides. If I had to nitpick, I'd say it would be nice if they were round in shape.
I used this after i dermaplane along with the enezyme pads they carry and it genuinely helped moisturize without feeling oily or feeling heavy.

This is a 2nd product of the same brand I'm using and really liking!! That nice cooling calming sensation after you apply the facial toner is the best. Thin pads really do the magic! I'm definitely getting another box of these.
Your skin will feel so amazing after use! Korean skincare is great for you- I tell all of my friends to purcahse Mediheal!

The essence is generously abundant and has a hydrating formula. The sheet is thin and soft, adhering well without falling off. There's enough leftover essence to absorb into the entire face, providing ample hydration. It was my first time using square­shaped pads, which felt more convenient than circular ones as they covered a larger area. With no irritation and a focus on moisturizing, it's easy to use. The tweezers...! I can't understand why they designed the tweezers in such a way that makes it so difficult for me. They're extremely inconvenient to use and truly useless...

avis.titre: The pads are gentle and don't...
avis.texte: The pads are gentle and don't irritate my skin, which I really appreciate. There's nothing particularly great or terrible about this product. I have combination skin with a slightly oily T­zone, and even when I leave it on like a mask, I don't feel like it's deeply hydrating. Instead, it seems to just sit on the surface of my skin. If anything, it feels like there might be too many nutrients, potentially causing blemishes. I wonder if it would be better to keep it in the fridge, but I haven't tried that yet.

Mediheal Watermide Deep Hydration Pad Key Ingredients: 10­layer Hyaluronic Acid Derma Gel Pad (Vegan­certified fabric) Deep hydration improvement effect Skin temperature reduction effect Review: I'm using Mediheal pads for the first time! The deep hydration pads are thin and soft, and they really adhere well to the skin. The gel pad is incredibly gentle, making it non­irritating even on skin texture. It has a sticky, moisturizing essence feel, so it's better suited as a hydration­boosting pack rather than an exfoliating toner you wipe off. However, it tends to dry quickly, so I don't leave it on for too long. Next time, I'd like to try their most famous(?) Madecassoside blemish pad. It doesn't seem to be saturated with essence While the 67mm size pad is quite large, it's still a bit disappointing when trying to cover both cheeks with one pad each The pads don't separate easily, and although they say the built­in tweezers have been redesigned, they're not particularly user­friendly The container is too big, though this might be because refills are sold separately

I've never seen such thin, skin­hugging pads before... The instant cooling effect and hydration when applied are amazing! I bought these without high expectations, but they turned out to be my favorite among Mediheal's pad lines. Personally, I love thin products that adhere well to the skin, and these fit the bill perfectly. It's like they're barely there! There's plenty of ampoule or essence inside, and the packaging is nicely done too. After applying, that area definitely feels more hydrated and soothed. I'll definitely be using these often from now on. I'm absolutely in love with them! Given how thin they are, they do seem to dry out pretty quickly. I suppose that's unavoidable!

this product worked so well at hydrating my face and is so versatile! if i need to use it for a boost of intensive hydration, i use it for longer and i need it on the run, i just use it as a toner pad! worked so well i had to buy it a second time!!

The pads are incredibly thin, and the amount of toner/serum is so generous that it's absolutely perfect for using as a mask! Despite the thinness of the pads, there's so much product that you can use it like a sheet mask without any irritation. As someone with dry skin who used to avoid pads at all costs, this product has completely changed my mind! Because they're so thin, it can be a bit tricky to separate the pads one by one... But I think that's unavoidable. It's not really a major issue for me. This product works hard to provide deep hydration and absorbs well into the skin. It's great for those with super sensitive skin or combination dehydrated skin, helping to even out the complexion and balance oil and moisture levels.

The hydration is top­notch! When I use it as a mask in the evening to refine my skin texture, I wake up with amazing moisture levels. I'm prone to severe acne, but since using this, my blemishes and pimples have significantly decreased. It's also great for makeup application in the morning ­ everything just glides on! On busy mornings, this is all you need. No need for toner and emulsion ­ this does it all! It provides deep hydration, and I'm already on my third bottle. Plus, it's such great value for the size. Definitely worth buying! If you have oily skin, you might want to try something else. As someone with oily skin, I find it makes my skin too greasy. It provides so much hydration that it actually makes my skin feel slippery. I only use it at night now. It's great as a nighttime mask, and it works wonderfully as a base for makeup in the morning too! Make sure to apply it generously on problem areas before going to bed.
Really good product, super hydrating, and reduces red splotchy inflamation.
i decided to try these based on a instagram person ; i love them. super hydrating.

avis.titre: My skin is sensitive, so I...
avis.texte: My skin is sensitive, so I can't use just anything, but the gentle ingredients in this product don't cause any issues. It contains various hydrating ingredients that leave my skin feeling moisturized after use. Great for improving deep dryness. The thin pads adhere well to the skin. Generous amount with 100 pads included. The pads are large in size. The built­in tweezers make it convenient to use. Refills are available, making it eco­friendly. It's a bit disappointing for exfoliation and blemish soothing. The container itself doesn't hold much essence. The thinness of the pads makes it difficult to separate them one by one. The tweezers are challenging to use. Works well as part of a daily mask routine. Storing it in the refrigerator enhances its soothing effects.

avis.titre: It's great to stick these on...
avis.texte: It's great to stick these on your cheeks while blow­drying your hair. They're small, so they stay put and don't fall off easily. They're inconvenient to take out. There's a clip, but you end up using your fingers. After applying and removing, your skin doesn't feel moisturized, just softened. It's hard to tell if they're actually providing hydration.

This is truly a life­changing pad! When I apply it while drying my hair, I don't feel any deep dryness at all. Well... I've seen many reviews saying the clip is uncomfortable, but I don't really notice it. It's good!

Hydration: Keeps skin moisturized all day long when applied in the morning. Blemishes: No breakouts at all, and skin seems to have improved a bit. Cooling effect: Feels genuinely refreshing when applied, even without refrigeration. Pads: The soft texture makes it perfect for sensitive skin types. The only drawback might be that they're a bit thin, making them slightly tricky to handle. Other than that, absolutely no cons. If you want to keep your skin hydrated all day, you absolutely must try this. I highly recommend it!
The toner pads are so hydrating and help my skin so much. I was skeptical at first, but I actually really enjoy it and would purchase again. Great product if you have dry skin!

It's so moisturizing and the pads are so large that you could easily use them as part of your daily mask routine. The tweezers are useless. I'm using the tweezers from my tea tree pads instead, which work much better. The pads are so thin that I often end up grabbing 2­3 at a time.

It's so moisturizing and the pads are so large that you could easily use them as part of your daily mask routine. The tweezers are useless. I'm using the tweezers from my tea tree pads instead, which work much better. The pads are so thin that I often end up grabbing 2­3 at a time.
It's more of a fun self care thing, it doesn't seem to work at all for me, it's refreshing though.

These toner pads are my go­to. They are so hydrating and I have noticed a difference in my skin since using them. I like to use them as face masks and leave them on for 15 minutes and it is so refreshing. Highly recommend
